components.name: TAK Server
components.what: the server itself, on every box that runs one
components.licence: US Government / TAK Product Center terms, licensed to the operator
components.offline: carried on the stick by you, never downloaded
components.version: 5.8 (the release the provisioner targets; the .deb is supplied by you)

components.name: PostgreSQL + PostGIS
components.version: 18 with PostGIS 3, from the PGDG archive

components.name: OpenJDK JRE
components.what: the Java runtime TAK Server's .deb depends on

components.name: MediaMTX
components.what: the video server behind the Streams page

components.name: Bai Jamjuree, Manrope, Roboto Mono
components.what: the console's three typefaces, embedded in the program and served by it
components.licence: SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 (text in console/fonts/)
components.offline: yes, embedded in the console; nothing is fetched at page load
components.note: embedded rather than laid beside the program because deploy-console base64-embeds the program alone, and a fonts directory would not travel that path. A box that is disconnected by design must not reach the internet to draw its own interface.
components.version: latin subsets from Google Fonts; the woff2 files in console/fonts/ are the source of truth and their SHA is the version

components.name: Ollama
components.what: the local model runtime on a box that carries one

components.name: Node-RED
components.note: pinned by image digest, which is the strongest pin here: a tag can be repointed at different bytes, a digest cannot

components.name: infra-TAK
components.what: an alternative stack, offered as a choice: its marketplace deploys the TAK ecosystem and Vantage manages the box underneath
components.note: every upstream release is tagged -alpha; there is no stable line, so the pin records what we have stood up rather than what is blessed

components.name: ufw, unattended-upgrades, qrencode
components.what: the hardening set and the QR encoder device enrolment needs
